why: UNIVERSES: A's theorems are taken at universe 0 (the UntamedCorner and HalfSpaceBundle examples have none). A_to_B: clauses (1)-(3) of B are proved from A's conjunct theorem_12_5_3_hyp (theorem A_to_B123: local homeomorphism via isLocalHomeomorph_orProj, two-point fibres from the hyp's fibre clause and Set.ncard_pair, transport sections via exists_isContOrOn and continuousOn_orSec). Clause (4) of B quantifies over an arbitrary sheet S and an arbitrary continuous local section τ, while A's push statements (theorem_12_5_3_push_hyp, pullOrx_morIso_eq_orMor) are about the chosen sheet X.sheetAt σ and a continuous orientation o (IsContOrOn); deriving (4) needs glue we did not complete: τ agrees locally with orSec o (eventually_eq_orSec_of_continuousOn), the inverses of t on S and on sheetAt ψ agree near t ψ, and the target set is open. We believe this direction holds; it is proof effort only. B_to_A: the two statements differ: A also contains the local-model versions (theorem_12_5_3_loc, push_loc, orProj_two_loc, theorem_6_6_17_loc), which need no bump functions or sc⁺-sections, the uniqueness of the orientation topology (∃! in theorem_12_5_3_hyp; B only names orTopology), the untamed-corner example showing the conclusion need not hold without tameness, the half-space example, and comparison lemmas between the two models; none follows from B without re-proving §12.5, so this is a genuine difference.
